core_insight: GITSEA can make repository contribution economically legible. Dan-Go makes contribution negotiable before it becomes economic.

mappings.dango_description: Append-only event log. Authority: none. Records claims, prerequisites, PRs, plan corrections.
mappings.gitsea_description: GITSEA records contribution events for stream eligibility assessment. Each event is auditable.
mappings.bridge_note: A Dan-Go negotiation produces contribution evidence. GITSEA may read that evidence to determine stream eligibility. Dan-Go does not activate the stream.

mappings.dango_description: A prerequisite that applies to a claim. Generates an issue draft. Negotiation required.
mappings.gitsea_description: GITSEA may require contribution conditions before a split becomes active.
mappings.bridge_note: Meeting a scoped prerequisite in Dan-Go is not the same as activating a GITSEA stream. It is evidence toward that activation.

mappings.dango_description: A prerequisite that does not apply in scope. Audit assertion only. No issue generated.
mappings.gitsea_description: A condition that GITSEA does not require for this contribution type.
mappings.bridge_note: Bypass in Dan-Go = audit log that the condition was assessed and found non-applicable. Not a waiver from an authority.

mappings.dango_description: A merged PR with gitsea_eligible flag. Evidence accepted. Negotiation may still reopen.
mappings.gitsea_description: A contribution event that may qualify for GITSEA stream inclusion.
mappings.bridge_note: PR merge is evidence. Not authority. gitsea_eligible: true signals potential stream candidacy only. No GITSEA stream is activated by this flag.

mappings.dango_description: plan_correction_proposed event appended to su-table. Original plan preserved. Correction is a proposal.
mappings.gitsea_description: GITSEA may record amendments to contribution claims when evidence is updated.
mappings.bridge_note: Dan-Go plan correction does not modify the GITSEA stream. It adds a new negotiation record that GITSEA can observe.

mappings.dango_description: Declares wallet address(es) and percentage splits for this repo. Advisory. No funds moved by Dan-Go.
mappings.gitsea_description: GITSEA reads split configuration to determine how stream proceeds are distributed.
mappings.bridge_note: Dan-Go reads and validates the split. GITSEA applies the split when a stream activates. These are separate operations.

mappings.dango_description: 乗数 (multiplier): scales royalty yield. Declared. Not computed. Not applied by Dan-Go.
mappings.gitsea_description: GITSEA uses royalty parameters to compute stream yield.
mappings.bridge_note: Dan-Go records the declared multiplier as advisory metadata. Yield computation is a GITSEA operation, not a Dan-Go operation.

mappings.dango_description: 保険 (insurance): merge_insurance = true. Declared intent. Not enforced by Dan-Go.
mappings.gitsea_description: GITSEA may offer merge insurance as a stream protection mechanism.
mappings.bridge_note: Dan-Go records the merge_insurance declaration. Whether it activates depends on GITSEA, not Dan-Go.

mappings.dango_description: participant_consent, revocable_consent fields. Checked at every negotiation step.
mappings.gitsea_description: GITSEA may require contributor consent before activating a split.
mappings.bridge_note: Dan-Go's dignity guard is protocol-level, not API-level. It does not call GITSEA consent APIs. It asserts consent in the negotiation record.

mappings.dango_description: No coordinator. No adjudicator. No enforcement. Evidence only.
mappings.gitsea_description: GITSEA may use an authority-free audit trail for stream eligibility decisions.
mappings.bridge_note: Dan-Go's authority: none is a protocol invariant, not a feature flag. GITSEA can read the Dan-Go audit trail without becoming an authority.

note: This mapping is advisory only. No GITSEA API is called. No stream is activated. No funds are moved. No wallet operation is performed.
